text:
maya: Scheduling a coordinated deploy tonight 22:00 UTC for runtime, router, console. Canary 10m. Need pins/flags from owners @sam @jordan @alex @priya

sam: Runtime 3.4.1-rc has eviction-latch fix. Recommend pin for canary only; keep 3.4.0 as fallback.

jordan: Router header-split depends on console header contract v2. Will gate via feature flag for canary if console not fully ready.

alex: Console backend implements v2; admin UI needs mapping update. We can delay UI roll until after canary.

priya: API team requests gateway routing TTL=60s for KV warmup during canary.

maya: Plan: sam pin runtime canary; jordan set header-split=false for canary; alex delay UI; priya set TTL=60s. Release notes to mention eviction latch and header flag.

sam: Pinning runtime now: orchctl pin --service runtime --version 3.4.1-rc --scope canary --metadata "eviction_latch=true"

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled in 15m.

(deploy)
deploy-bot: Canary started: runtime=3.4.1-rc (10%), router header-split=false, console backend v2, gateway TTL=60s. Monitoring: https://console/mon/runtimes/3.4.1-rc

jordan: Noticing p95 routing queue increase on auth-proxy routes (+45ms).

sam: Seeing transient KV eviction spikes during warmup in kernel logs.

alex: Admin API 502 spike: 0.6% -> 1.8% for ~90s, seems console->router handshake timeouts.

maya: Close to thresholds. Rollback triggers: error rate >2% for 3m OR p95 >300ms for 2m.

jordan: Auth-proxy p95 hit 320ms sustained ~2m.

priya: Small subset of production keys showing customer-facing errors; vendor federation alerted.

maya: Given p95 breach + vendor alert + 502s, executing rollback now. Sam, Jordan, please run rollback.

sam: Rolling runtime back to 3.4.0: orchctl rollback --service runtime --to-version 3.4.0 --reason "canary p95 & vendor errors"

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for runtime. Canary halted. Unpinning router feature flag.
jordan: Reverting router flag: orchctl set-flag router header-split false --scope global --source canary-revert (done)

ops-bot: Eviction spikes subsiding; connections normalizing. p95 back under baseline in ~90s.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: runtime -> 3.4.0. Router flag confirmed false. Canary aborted.

maya: Good job. Actions: RCA for console handshake with header-split, controlled KV warmup in runtime, extend canary ramp +5m next attempt, add eviction-burst metric alert. Update release notes: 3.4.1-rc blocked pending perf tuning. Schedule post-deploy sync tomorrow 14:00 UTC.

alex: I'll add a note to release doc and gate UI mapping behind toggle.

sam: Will implement controlled KV warmup and eviction-burst metric.

priya: Leaving release note stub: "Eviction latch candidate rolled back after canary - see postmortem."

deploy-bot: Thread closed by maya.
